  context={"endpoint"}

</MethodEndpoint>



Count and measure the records a purge would delete, and the disk space
compacting afterwards would hand back.

This is a range scan over the entire purge set, so on an archive that has
never been purged it takes seconds — callers should expect a slow read
and set their timeout accordingly.
